answer: Sybil weight never exceeds bonded scarce capacity: each identity's voting power is capped by onyx collateral locked to one attested hardware vertex. First condition: registration requires a unique TPM-rooted key plus bond, so cloning wallets is cheap but cloning capacity is not. Second: a rotating violet audit committee challenges random nodes with live compute proofs; unresponsive or duplicate roots forfeit onyx to auditors. Farm 10k identities, post 10k bonds, still need 10k real machines.
